book.name: 2 Tesalonika
book.title: PAS NAMBA TU PAULO MENI TESALONIKA EMARE GAENUA

content: Utura ge gera-gaira wai bamu ami kei awai amire Yesura
be zora awamunoya.
Otao mamai, Tua nasokai Yesu Kristo ewesemai be nusore ata nakai numore dai poti dara nai amira ge zo sanakare niniu.

Ema eni nukare “Tuara be bamu kei awitaya” asinoise Ozana meni ema zore sisita, ota ema zo meni kotumai nusora sisita, ota nukare nanekare pas numorekare ago potisenikareta?, ago samunora awa. Are etetenai ge ago ine awa kei awai nikare eya oko titibi awero kotumai sisero itazaita wawe. Nikare ago wai azu tonakare.
Etetenai ge zota zo sara oko niniu. Nera kota, Tua be nuso zora awamu inuai gita ge dai bamu kei awamunoya. Ago kei awai ge dai ema, nu dega niaore amira gegenai, ami kei damu namunoya awa.

Nu ami tama nuso puro wititinoise nena ema meni bowi inowera, o nena ema meni “Tua” asinowera awa dapikarago iwo inoise puro osero tepo wamunoya awa. Ago wero witiro Anutura ibu bamu amira arumuro itise amire nu nutope samunoya awa, “Nama Anutu awa.”
Na gita nisokare nana noise ema amira ge nikare tugata wena. Awa nikare kotupitinowewita?
Be zeme emire ge dai bamu amira gazai itia, awa ninitinowa, awa daitai amire ge dai ema meni be nusora kei damu namunoya awa.
Be zeme emire ge dai meni bua nuso tura-tura inowia awa. Ota eba gazinowia nu daitai amire

ge dai ema awa kei damu namunoya awa. Nu kei damu nai amire Tua Yesura be so amira ozana meni pisai ema awa dai betamunoya awa. Tua Yesu nu kei damu nitinoise zasimai nuso bamu meni ge dai ema amira putou awa puro osero tepo-tapo wamunoya awa.
Etetenai witai kei awamunoya.
Ge dai ema amira ge eni susumuro sane. Ema awa nu Satan meni mama wai putou neire-neire amire dai kei awero tani putoure opi, o tani benau sekare opi awa inoise
ema sisaira gegenai awa etetenai waya meni etetenamunoya. Nukare sisamunora, nera kota, nukare Anutu meni nukare soero paise ge me nuso ninamu yaba kaka wamu inowera awa.
Ago inowera, are nukare ge opi awa ninara me waise sero Anutu meni etetenaira putou potai kei awai ge opi awa ninamunora.
Awa nukare ge me giwa me kaka wamu wenu giro doro nena waya-kawaya amira ara tapinowera ema awa ina nusokare kei awaise sero Anutu meni ago ine wamunoya awa.
Nikare meni awa zewai wewo. Nera kota, Anutu meni nikare soero pumamu ginu itewia.

Otao mamai, Tua meni nikare awa ara tapinowia. Ozana meni nikare wayara ena uzupitinuai nikare Yesu nana susumuro ge me ninawa me wai ewanana wawise sero Anutu meni emokore zaawaira ena nikare siana-katana wero pumunua awa. Ami emo be giti numore kokopai asanisekare duba nasokare meni wititinowia awa.
Anutu nu Oziga Ewanana nimorekare sanakare niniro Tua nasokai Yesu Kristora simai zasimaire awa topetiro mama wawise sero nikare zawa sero kora wenua awa.
Are otao mamai, nikare zewai wero ge be nasokare meni ata pas meni sero gipero awenakare awa ziro tata-tata inoise noiwo.
Tua nasokai Yesu Kristo nu nutope ata Anutu Mama nasokai, nu nakai emo zo bamubake amuro nakai soga inoise uzutai itai gege itai, o tuma diai kokopai awa namorekai potinua, nu ami
duba nisokare ziai zewai wai de ike nitinuai amire ge ewanana sise bua ewanana wise awinoise noiwo.
